title: JLCPCB parts library
what_they_did: JLCPCB's public parts-library page is the search front end for the electronic components its SMT assembly service can place, and every part there carries a Basic or Extended library class.
useful_for_us: Checked first for every candidate so we only list parts that JLCPCB can actually assemble.

title: Murata BLM15H_SN series chip ferrite bead reference specification (JENF243A-0024K-01)
what_they_did: The Murata reference specification for the BLM15H_SN GHz-noise ferrite beads lists the rated impedance, DC resistance and rated current of each part and gives the soldering and land-pattern rules.
useful_for_us: It is the primary datasheet for the BLM15HD182SN1D ferrite bead and states 1800 ohm at 100 MHz and 2700 ohm at 1 GHz for that part.

title: LCSC C76888 Murata BLM15HD182SN1D product page
what_they_did: The LCSC product page gives the BLM15HD182SN1D 0402 ferrite bead's key attributes, stock and price, and links the manufacturer datasheet.
useful_for_us: It supplies the LCSC stock figure and the LCSC one-off price for the bead we were asked to source.

title: LCSC C190862 Winbond W25Q128JVPIQ product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the Winbond W25Q128JVPIQ 128 Mbit QSPI NOR flash in the WSON-8-EP(5x6) package with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: Confirms the exact requested flash part exists at LCSC in the 6 x 5 mm WSON-8 package.

title: Winbond W25Q128JVPIQ datasheet (via LCSC)
what_they_did: The Winbond W25Q128JV datasheet describes the 128 Mbit 3.3 V serial QSPI NOR flash family, its WSON-8 land pattern and the pin-compatible package options.
useful_for_us: Gives the package and interface details needed to say the part is the requested 128 Mbit 3.3 V QSPI flash in a 6 x 5 mm WSON-8.

title: LCSC C2441427 Winbond W25Q128JVPIM product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the W25Q128JVPIM-TR 128 Mbit NOR flash in the same WSON-8-EP(5x6) package with its stock and price tiers.
useful_for_us: It is the pin-compatible WSON-8 6x5 alternative to the requested flash if the exact part is ever out of stock.

title: LCSC C3001859 ISSI IS25LP128-JKLE product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the ISSI IS25LP128-JKLE 128 Mbit 3.3 V QSPI NOR flash in a WSON-8-EP(5x6) package with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: It is a second pin-compatible WSON-8 6x5 128 Mbit 3.3 V QSPI flash alternative for the sensor pod.

title: LCSC C32713285 hanxia HX PZ2.54-2x5P TP product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the hanxia HX PZ2.54-2x5P TP dual-row 2.54 mm surface-mount pin header and states its insulation height and stock.
useful_for_us: It is the surface-mount 2x5 header chosen to match the KiCad PinHeader_2x05_P2.54mm_Vertical_SMD footprint.

title: hanxia HX PZ2.54-2x5P TP datasheet drawing
what_they_did: The hanxia drawing gives the 2.54 mm dual-row SMD header's pin length above the plastic (6.00 plus or minus 0.2 mm), plastic height (2.50 mm) and recommended PCB pad layout.
useful_for_us: Supplies the pin-length-above-plastic and plastic-height values the task asked for item 3.

title: LCSC C41417359 hanxia HX PZ2.54-1x2P TP-YQ product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the hanxia HX PZ2.54-1x2P TP-YQ single-row 1x2 surface-mount header with staggered pins and states its insulation height and stock.
useful_for_us: It is the staggered-pad 1x2 SMD header chosen to match the KiCad PinHeader_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical_SMD_Pin1Left footprint.

title: hanxia HX PZ2.54-1x2P TP-YQ datasheet drawing
what_they_did: The hanxia drawing gives the 2.54 mm staggered SMD header's pin length above the plastic (6.00 plus or minus 0.2 mm), plastic height (2.50 mm) and the Type A / Type B mirror-image pad layouts.
useful_for_us: Supplies the pin-style values for item 6 and shows the two staggered layouts that correspond to KiCad Pin1Left and Pin1Right.

title: LCSC C20826701 Harwin P70-1100045R product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the Harwin P70-1100045R surface-mount spring-loaded pogo pin with its stock and price tiers.
useful_for_us: It is the tall SMD pogo pin chosen for item 4 and gives its LCSC and JLCPCB stock position.

title: Harwin P70-1100045R SMT spring-loaded pogo pin datasheet
what_they_did: The Harwin customer information sheet gives the P70 series SMT pogo pin's free height, maximum/normal/minimum working heights, spring force, current rating, plating thickness, durability and recommended PCB pad size.
useful_for_us: It is the datasheet source of every mechanical value the task asked for the tall pogo pin.

title: LCSC C7464877 Harwin P70-2300045R product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the Harwin P70-2300045R surface-mount pogo pin with its stock and price tiers.
useful_for_us: It is the second tall pogo-pin option with a slightly lower working height and a smaller recommended pad.

title: LCSC C2682616 Analog Devices MAX17048G+T10 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the MAX17048G+T10 1-cell ModelGauge fuel gauge in the DFN-8-EP(2x2) package with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: It gives the LCSC stock and price for the fuel gauge and confirms the 2 x 2 mm TDFN-8 package.

title: Maxim MAX17048/MAX17049 datasheet (19-6171 Rev 7, via LCSC)
what_they_did: The official Maxim MAX17048/MAX17049 datasheet gives the pin/bump table, the supply-current table, the unused-pin guidance and the ordering information for the 1-cell and 2-cell fuel gauges.
useful_for_us: It is the source for the exact TDFN-8 pin table and for what the datasheet says to do with CTG, QSTRT and ALRT when unused.

title: LCSC C7497002 Analog Devices MAX17048X+T10 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the MAX17048X+T10 fuel gauge in the WLP-8 (0.9 x 1.7 mm) package and shows it is out of stock.
useful_for_us: It documents the wafer-level-package version of the fuel gauge and that it is not currently usable.

title: LCSC C165948 Korean Hroparts TYPE-C-31-M-12 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the TYPE-C-31-M-12 16-position USB-C receptacle with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: It is the USB-C 2.0 receptacle chosen for the small charging board and gives its stock and class.

title: Korean Hroparts TYPE-C-31-M-12 USB-C receptacle drawing
what_they_did: The manufacturer drawing gives the 16-pin USB-C receptacle's dimensions, pin numbering and the full A1/B12 to A8/B8 pinout including the CC1/CC2 pins.
useful_for_us: It confirms the connector is a true USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle with CC pins broken out for charging negotiation.

title: LCSC C113952 MDD SMAJ5.0A product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the MDD SMAJ5.0A unidirectional 5 V TVS diode in DO-214AC (SMA) with its clamp voltage, peak pulse power and stock.
useful_for_us: It is the 5 V TVS chosen for the USB charging board and gives its LCSC and JLCPCB stock and price.

title: MDD SMAJ5.0A TVS diode datasheet
what_they_did: The MDD datasheet gives the SMAJ5.0A standoff voltage, breakdown voltage, clamping voltage, peak pulse power and SMA package outline.
useful_for_us: It supplies the electrical values used to justify the 5 V unidirectional TVS choice.

title: LCSC C5221287 YIYUAN YTC1P-2010-01 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the YIYUAN YTC1P-2010-01 single SMD pogo pin with its stock and price and links its drawing.
useful_for_us: It is the shortest JLCPCB-placeable SMD pogo pin found for item 8 and gives its stock and price.

title: YIYUAN YTC1P-2010-01 pogo pin drawing
what_they_did: The YIYUAN drawing gives the YTC1P-2010-01 pogo pin's free height (3.00 mm), working height (2.30 mm), plunger and barrel diameters, spring force, current rating, plating and durability.
useful_for_us: It supplies every mechanical and electrical value for the short pogo pin that is closest to the requested height range.

title: LCSC C2988082 BAT WIRELESS BWCD-L3W2.0H1.0 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the BAT WIRELESS BWCD-L3W2.0H1.0 SMD pogo pin with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: It is an alternative short SMD pogo pin for item 8 with a published current rating and a lower price.

title: BAT WIRELESS BWCD-L3W2.0H1.0 pogo pin datasheet
what_they_did: The BAT WIRELESS datasheet gives the 3.0 x 2.0 x 1.0 mm SMD pogo pin's 1.5 A current rating, 100 gf spring force, gold-plated brass construction and 10000-cycle durability.
useful_for_us: It provides the alternative short pogo pin's current, force, plating and durability values.

title: LCSC C5378168 ZHOURI PZ2.54-2*5-SMT product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the ZHOURI PZ2.54-2*5-SMT dual-row 2.54 mm SMD pin header with its insulation height and stock.
useful_for_us: It is a cheaper second option for the 2x5 SMD header with a datasheet-stated pin length.

title: LCSC C456012 SHOU HAN TYPE-C 6P product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the SHOU HAN TYPE-C 6P surface-mount USB-C receptacle rated 5 V 3 A with its stock and price.
useful_for_us: It is the power-only 6-pin USB-C alternative for the charging board when CC negotiation is not needed.

title: JLCPCB PCB capabilities
what_they_did: JLCPCB's capabilities page lists the finished thickness options, the minimum via hole and diameter, and the minimum track width and spacing for multilayer boards, including the note that 0.1 mm microvias need a board thickness of 1 mm or less with ENIG or OSP.
useful_for_us: It is the page quoted for whether 1.2 mm and 1.0 mm 6-layer boards are offered and whether thickness changes the via and track rules.

title: JLCPCB instant quote page
what_they_did: The public instant-quote page embeds JLCPCB's per-layer thickness configuration and calls the public calculation endpoint that returns the board, finish and total prices.
useful_for_us: Its embedded configuration and quote endpoint produced the 6-layer 24 x 30 mm ENIG price comparison at 1.2 mm versus 1.6 mm.

title: YIYUAN YTC1P-1807-01 pogo pin drawing
what_they_did: The YIYUAN drawing gives the YTC1P-1807-01 pogo pin's free height (2.50 mm), working height (2.00 mm), maximum compression, plunger/barrel/base diameters, spring force, current rating, plating and 20,000-cycle durability.
useful_for_us: It is the datasheet source for the short pogo pin chosen for item 8.

title: LCSC C42419351 YIYUAN YTC1P-1807-01 product page
what_they_did: The LCSC page lists the YIYUAN YTC1P-1807-01 SMD pogo pin with its 2.5 mm overall height, 2.0 mm working height, 1 A rating, 20,000-cycle durability and stock.
useful_for_us: It confirms the short pogo pin is in stock and gives its price and cycle rating.

title: YIYUAN POGO PIN series selection table
what_they_did: The YIYUAN series table lists every YTC1P size with its A and B lengths, working height C, stroke D, and part number, and states 12 V 1.5 A max, 100 gf +/-20 gf and 10,000-cycle durability for the series.
useful_for_us: It gives the free and working heights of the tall YTC1P-4520-01 alternative for item 4.

title: Xinyangze YZ50315020R-03 pogo pin datasheet
what_they_did: The Xinyangze datasheet gives the YZ50315020R-03 SMD pogo pin's 12 V 1 A rating, 130 gf spring force, 10,000-cycle durability and its mechanical dimensions.
useful_for_us: It is the datasheet for the alternative short pogo pin with thicker gold plating.

title: Harwin P70-10X0045R SMT pogo pin datasheet
what_they_did: The Harwin customer information sheet covers the P70-1000045R to P70-1030045R SMT pogo pins and tabulates free height, maximum/normal/minimum working height, packing and force for each.
useful_for_us: It verifies the 3.50 mm free and 2.90 mm working height of the P70-1000045R that the shorter pogo pin has to replace.

title: Murata BLM15 series S-parameter data archive
what_they_did: The archive contains the measured 2-port S-parameter files for the Murata BLM15 ferrite bead series, including BLM15HD182SN1.s2p with 401 frequency points from 1 MHz to 3 GHz referenced to 50 Ohm.
useful_for_us: Converting its S21 to a series impedance gives the 2.4 GHz impedance of the BLM15HD182SN1D (1009 Ohm), the value that decides item 1.
